description: Reference table of all ticketing platforms in the network. Small, slowly-changing dimension (SCD-1) — only current state is retained. Cleaned and deduplicated in silver_platforms (full refresh). Joined to silver_tickets via platform_source=platform_name in gold_ticket_sales_daily, gold_regional_summary, and gold_channel_performance to provide regional context.

fields.name: platform_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the ticketing platform. Primary key — tested with not_null and unique in sources.yml. Referenced as FK from raw_ticketing.channels.platform_id.

fields.name: platform_name
fields.description: Human-readable platform name. Standardised to INITCAP in silver_platforms. Used as the join key between silver_tickets.platform_source and silver_platforms in Gold models.

fields.name: platform_region
fields.description: Primary geographic region of the platform. Expected values: US, EU, APAC, LATAM. Standardised to UPPER in silver_platforms. Core dimension in gold_regional_summary for regional revenue breakdowns.

fields.name: launch_date
fields.description: Date when this platform went live. Cast to DATE in silver_platforms.

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the platform is currently active and processing ticket sales. Cast to BOOL in silver_platforms.
